messages:
Dana: Short thread to lock owners for recurring incident themes from the 90-day rollup. Link: https://redwood.internal/insights/90d-recurrence. Top themes: downstream throttle bursts, autoscaler drift, canary overlap, cache eviction spikes.

Omar: Can we pick owners for small, testable mitigations (<=2w) + automation follow-ups?

Dana: Proposed owners: Omar -> throttles, Riley -> autoscaler, Sophie -> canary guardrails, Dana -> cache tuning. ETA targets: mitigation in 10 business days, automation after.

Riley: I'll add a CI lint + nightly diff for autoscaler YAMLs. PR by 2026-05-29.

Sophie: Canary preflight check + runbook snippet. Small PR by 2026-06-02.

Omar: Throttles: per-host leaky bucket + immediate shed + dashboard tile. Need a staging harness. Opening INF-5120. ETA for mitigation PR 2026-06-04.

Dana: Cache: add TTL jitter + soft-evict bump, run perf test. ETA 2026-05-27.

PagerBot: Follow-up ticket INC-RECUR-2026-1701 created and assigned -> Omar, Riley, Sophie, Dana. Due 2026-06-12.

Riley: Suggest adding columns in tracker: regression?, est monthly cost avoided, postmortems tagged.

Dana: Donetracker link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/recurrence-90d.csv. Scheduling a 20m recurring sync monthly to review progress. First meeting 2026-05-21 09:30 PT.

Omar: If infra blocks, I'll prototype a local stub. Will update ticket INF-5120 with details.

Sophie: I'll include a canary safety gate so overlapping active model IDs are rejected. Small playbook note too.

Dana: Owners please update tracker + follow-up ticket with PR/ticket IDs by ETAs. If blocked, reply here with blocker IDs.

All: ack
